_about: The static cost table cost.py reads. W: one fresh Opus input token weighted by price (token_report.py). plans: each plan's weekly limit as a multiple of Pro (public: Max 5x and Max 20x). pro_week_w: Pro's weekly limit in W, from a calibration week (cost.py calibrate); null until one is in, and every share of a week is then unknown. steps: [low, high, source] in W per step; source 'estimate' or where it was measured. steady_week: how many of each step a steady week holds. target: the share of a Pro week a steady week may take.

application: measured: applier agent to a whole overnight run per sent job
coordinator_day: estimate: a fresh coordinator per day (one measured day, 2.2M)
